description: This file defines the 'Information' model class within the OpenCart's admin catalog module. The class provides methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting information records in the database, along with managing related descriptions, stores, layouts, and SEO URLs.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: A model class handling CRUD operations and related management for 'information' entries in the OpenCart admin catalog module.

methods.name: addInformation
methods.description: Creates a new information record in the database, including descriptions, store assignments, SEO URLs, and layouts, then clears the cache.

methods.name: editInformation
methods.description: Updates an existing information record and its related descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts, then clears the cache.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific information record and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteInformation
methods.description: Deletes an information record along with associated descriptions, store links, layouts, and SEO URLs, then clears the cache.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific information record with its details and descriptions.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Fetches a list of information records based on optional filters such as store, status, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalInformations
methods.description: Returns the total count of information records matching specified filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a particular information record in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all description entries associated with a given information record.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all description entries for a specified language across all information entries.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific information record.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an information record with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Deletes store associations for a specific information record.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all information associations with a particular store.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs linked to a specific information record.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Assigns a layout to an information record for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for an information record.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Removes all information entries associated with a particular layout.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout IDs assigned to an information record per store.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts how many information records are associated with a specific layout.
